rules.statement: The damage sustained by the respondent was too remotely connected to the negligence of the appellant in wrongly describing the property mortgaged, and the respondent was guilty of contributory negligence.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that the question of contributory negligence depends upon any breach of duty as between the plaintiff and a negligent defendant; it depends entirely on the question whether the plaintiff could reasonably have avoided the consequences of the defendant's negligence."
